prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Select a personality style to preview your pet live before bringing them home.", "Choose Companion Visual Style"]
1: ["How to Interact With Your Desktop Pet", "Right-click your pet anytime to hide, summon, or open settings. Drag anywhere across screens.", "Got It, Let's Go!", "Right-click for options | Drag to move | Double-click to chat"]
2: ["Define Your Pet's Trait & Vibe", "Pick traits that describe how active or relaxed you want your desktop companion to be.", "Confirm Companion Traits", "Playful, Calm, Focused, or Mischievous"]
3: ["Save Your New Pet to Your Account", "Sign in to ensure your pet settings and memory persist across app restarts and devices.", "Use your primary account so your pet state is never lost."]
4: ["Preset path: instant setup. Custom path: tailor pet look from photos."]
5: ["Important: Sign in with your existing account to restore existing pets, or use a new email to create a new pet."]
6: ["Preparing Your Pet Desktop Assets...", "We are calibrating screen boundaries and pet animations. You can minimize this window."]
7: ["Your Companion is Ready on Your Screen!", "Look at your desktop to find your pet. Click below to trigger their first wave animation.", "Say Hello to Pet"]
8: ["Select Your Onboarding Experience", "Quick Start (1-Min Preset Pet) vs Custom Creator (Photo Upload)"]
9: ["Use clear, single-subject photos with good lighting for best 3D pet rendition results.", "Well-lit photo | Single subject | Clear front profile"]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal contact information (email address).
